clue.text: Somehow I stop before edge of precipice catching two females on dangerous slope?

explanation.definitionFit: Skiing away from the groomed trails means unprepared snow, which can be hazardous terrain; the question mark flags the loose fit.

clue.text: Troubled airman finally cradled in fog making his manoeuvre to counteract weather?
